newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE trade subdued ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE trade subdued ahead of results.

text.p: Trade was relatively subdued on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Monday, reflecting a drifting underlying market ahead of the release of third quarter corporate results this week and next.

Philips options figured stongly, taking almost 15 percent of the total volume, and evenly split between calls and puts as sentiment remined mixed over the company's sharp drop in third quarter earnings and announced restructuring programme.
Put options in the EOE contract were more active than calls reflecting nervousness over the near-term direction of the index. Some dealers have predited an iminent correction.

But others were more bullish, citing very strong chart support at 580 points and advocating a call buying strategy to take advatage of an upside move to the 610 area. One broker said investors should purchase 590 November calls, which were trading around 5.50 guilders on Monday.
